notes.title: September Update
notes.notes:
Howdy Ranchers!

We've been hard at work bringing you some exciting new features and improvements! Here's what's coming to Rockhound:

[b]Post Office [/b]- You can finally step inside and meet Delilah, our postmaster! This retired Pony Express courier has seen it all and has plenty of stories to share. At the Post Office, you'll be able to:
[list]
[*] Order crafting supplies - Purchase rare crafting materials or furniture from the brochure.
[*] Snoop on the locals - Read their personal mail.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43543621/62f221307d342aca8e62b81bea7f3d32f522fa9e.gif[/img]

[b]Puzzles[/b] - As part of Chauncey's Quest, you'll venture into the Hotel basement and need to solve a few puzzles to get the boiler back up and running. We'll be collecting feedback on these puzzles regarding difficulty and accessibility.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43543621/2d03860d8aa0cfffa027c02ba75d03cbb82f1397.gif[/img]

[b]Better Visual Interaction Cues[/b] - No more guessing what you can interact with! Objects you can use now display a helpful blue outline when you're nearby, making exploration more intuitive and reducing frustration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43543621/53bf255d6efae46faa908cf3973b202883784fac.gif[/img]

🎮 What's Coming Next

[b]Controller Support[/b] - We're putting the finishing touches on full controller compatibility! This was a tremendous effort as it required reworking some of the UI to make sense when using a controller.

This feature should be ready for the next demo release. We're testing extensively with Steam Deck to ensure smooth gameplay - this should hopefully work similarly with other handheld gaming devices like the ROG Ally.

As always, thank you for your support and patience. Join us on [url=https://discord.gg/zCCj6UzBRk]Discord[/url].

Borispixel

notes.title: Vampire Rancher is in Tiny Teams Festival! Demo Out Now!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Ranchers![/p]

[p]I've been hard at work polishing, improving, and addressing feedback for Vampire Rancher. I'm glad to say that our demo will be available to play in participation of [b]Tiny Teams from August 7th to 14th.[/b][/p]

[p]Here's what's new in development:[/p]

[h2][b]New Faces[/b][/h2]

Everyone’s got a face now - no more mysterious featureless folks roaming the world. This was a highly requested feature, and it took a while to get the art style nailed down ([i]who knew drawing pixel art faces was so hard[/i]). What do you think? Down the line, you'll be able to customize your eye color too.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rkTrEkw.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Map: Now With You On It[/b][/h2]

You’ll now see your current location on the map. This one was highly requested from the last public demo, so navigating town and its outskirts should be more clear now.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6oJsoz5.gif[/img]

[h2][b]The Midnight Company Quest + Brewing Tutorial[/b][/h2]

The Midnight Company quest now connects more clearly with the brewing tutorial, making the early game smoother and (hopefully) more intuitive. You’ll learn the basic mechanics—and why you’re doing it.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Mqj3RMO.gif[/img]

[h2][b]General Store Changes[/b][/h2]

You can now sell items at the general store, with payment arriving at the end of each day. That said, not every item is a good sell—some things (like crops) are far more profitable when cooked into food and sold directly at the saloon.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qFxVPGR.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Bloodcrafting Improvements[/b][/h2]

Blood can be analyzed to generate blood tokens. Tokens, combined with drinking a traveler's blood, are used to unlock new technologies. Every traveler type first unlock gives you a craftable workstation. That means you’ll be able to start producing useful items faster than ever. In the demo, these include:
[list]
[*] Bee Hotel
[*] Smoker
[*] Oil Press
[*] Fishing Pot
[*] Kiln
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SyIk9f5.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Lair Builder 1.0[/b][/h2]

The first version of the lair-building system is here! Expand your vampire lair by constructing new rooms underground. You can also begin customizing wall textures and lighting setups. Stay tuned as more themes and props are in the works.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JUOVPH8.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Quality of Life Improvements[/b][/h2]

While controller and gamepad are still being actively worked on, I've addressed various bugs, QoL and stability improvements. There's also a new face in town, as well as updated quest dialogue in some parts, but I'll leave that for you to discover.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UmqwuQY.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dTvNmIl.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/w422nt3.gif[/img]

As always, thank you for support and following our journey! If you're interested in participating in a closed beta, please check out our Discord.

The demo will be open for two weeks (1 week more than Tiny Teams), so that we have enough time to collect feedback.

- Borispixel

notes.title: 2024 Year-End Development Update
notes.notes:
It’s been a few months since our last update and as we wrap up 2024, I wanted to share what we’ve been working on.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Roh9Z4L.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/pgtETeG.gif[/img]

I’ve been adding new characters, but I want to highlight Arthur, our resident museum curator with a peculiar fascination for ancient artifacts.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qa2ur5N.gif[/img]

You’ll be able to collect various artifacts you find in the world in the museum and even auction them off for gold. Naturally, higher-tier and wealthier visitors will be willing to spend more, making this an excellent way to earn additional gold.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/V24orNK.gif[/img]

As a vampire, the sun is not your friend! Lingering too long in the morning hours will result in some crispy consequences. You’ll incinerate - losing blood and gold. Make sure you get back to your coffin (or at the very least, indoors) in time! However, as you rise through the ranks of the vampiric council and grow stronger, you’ll be able to resist the sunlight a little longer with the help of some nifty crafting recipes.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ketoadf.gif[/img]

We’ve been focusing on worldbuilding, drawing inspiration from vampire mythos and popular media. Be sure to interact with and examine objects to uncover pieces of lore and even new crafting recipes.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/s5RzNWB.gif[/img]

Based on feedback, I’ve introduced a larger homestead area south of the town where you can build your farm and place crafting stations as you please. This area is still a work in progress but it will include new structures that you can repair and upgrade over time. You’ll need to complete a few quests to unlock this area first.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZpmhmhO.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KHSG5v2.gif[/img]

A big thank you to our closed beta testers! I’m happy to report that your feedback has been addressed along with many other issues. Keep an eye out for a new build in the coming weeks with tons more content as we push towards Early Access in 2025.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RvF0apB.gif[/img]

As we close out the year, we want to express our gratitude to all who have supported Vampire Rancher’s development! As a tiny team, your enthusiasm keeps us going. Wishing everyone a happy and restful holiday season and a fantastic new year.

- Borispixel

notes.title: Reeling in Updates! August Devlog
notes.notes:
Hey Ranchers! I'm thrilled to share some of the latest updates that I've been working on for Vampire Rancher.

This devlog will cover the new and improved fishing mechanics, a small update to quests, a sleek  summary screen, and a peek into bosses you may encounter in the mines.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/AVrK1jk.gif[/img]

First up, fishing! Get your fishing rod handy if you notice any fish swimming around in the nearby ponds. You'll be able to cook fish into recipes like Fish Stew, and use their guts for compost. Additionally, you'll be able to use baits like Worms and Feathers to catch rarer fish.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ufux4XJ.gif[/img]

Quests are an integral part of Vampire Rancher, so I've been writing and refining quests lines out. In addition to the usual fetch and delivery quests, I've added a bit of puzzle-solving and mini challenges to keep things fresh.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/c5AV8sw.gif[/img]

Once you've ended your night (or day) in your coffin, you'll be prompted with a summary page. This'll be a recap of what you've accomplished that "day". I'll eventually add a detailed version of this view if you're  into stats and all that.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HYAacbW.gif[/img]

For those who crave a bit more bloodlust, here's a preview of Millicent the Mad, one of the bosses you may encounter in the mines as you explore the Vampiric Ruins. Players will be rewarded with crafting recipes and loot for defeating these bosses.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NZGKlpb.gif[/img]

And that concludes this round of updates! We hope you're as excited as we are about these. Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being a part of our community!

notes.title: Fang-tastic Brewing
notes.notes:
Howdy Ranchers!

Welcome to the first Devlog of 2024! This post, I’m excited to share updates to the Brewing Skill. You’ll be able to brew beverages for your Saloon, and also potions down the line.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Cq6v4dU.gif[/img]

To brew Ale, we can start by growing crops like Hops and Barley. You’ll have to water, tend, and grow them, just like any other farm crops by the light of the moon (or sun, when you get strong enough!). 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DPIF9rY.gif[/img]

Start the fermentation process by using these ingredients in a Fermentation Vat, then inside a Cask.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6YS2u8S.gif[/img]

Eventually, you’ll be able to brew Spirits like Whiskey, and more interestingly - potions, with rare ingredients.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/81f8oYi.gif[/img]

Serve these to your Visitors and Guests to ensure they’re happy. The happier the human, the tastier the blood.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/niHL9Fm.gif[/img]

We’ve also spent time updating the UI for the Skill Tree. You’ll be able to level up as you gain experience through different skills. Each Talent in the Skill Tree can be upgraded with Talent Points, which you can get from naturally leveling up, or feeding from certain types of humans. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bxUsRRu.gif[/img]

We’re looking for beverage ideas, so if you’ve got a cool name for a beer, ale, or any other drink, let us know here: [url=https://forms.gle/ogDTjNY3ez1ovHPFA]https://forms.gle/ogDTjNY3ez1ovHPFA[/url]

As always, please let us know if you have any feedback or suggestions, and stay tuned for more updates as we continue to develop Vampire Rancher.

notes.title: Vampire Rancher December Devlog
notes.notes:
Hey Ranchers! I’m thrilled to bring you the latest update for Vampire Rancher. As we begin the holiday season, let's dive into the details of what's new in this month's devlog!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7L3G47e.gif[/img]

[b]Forageable Creatures[/b] 🐌

In the corners of your town, you'll now find forageable critters! These creatures, like snails and frogs, are more than just garden pests; they're valuable resources waiting to be discovered. Collect them and use them in various cooking recipes, alchemical potions, and collect their eggs to create a mini-menagerie. So make sure to keep an eye out for these charming critters during your strolls.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DYlzbC8.gif[/img]

[b]Rainy Nights[/b] ☔

I’ve worked on adding rain to Vampire Rancher. Say hello to gentle rain showers that not only add a soothing ambiance but also bring benefits to your crops. Rain will automatically water your crops to save you some time. Note that the rain might affect the mood of certain town guests, so be sure to stock up your tavern with mood-boosting foods and drinks.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JaA5ek0.gif[/img]

[b]New Shop: Seed & Sundry[/b] 🌱

Seed & Sundry is your one-stop shop for all your farming needs! You’ll be able to buy seeds, farming tools, and other sundries to help you grow better and more crops. I’m still developing Seed & Sundry’s shopkeeper, so keep an eye out for this character in a later update.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xPEP9Dq.gif[/img]

[b]Cooking UI Improvements[/b] 🍲

I’ve spent some time improving the cooking and crafting screens. You’ll be able to see the different recipes, their ingredients, and fuel costs more clearly. The quality and nature of your ingredients can affect the traits of the cooked meal.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/crARMsO.gif[/img]

[b]Fuel System for Crafting[/b] 🔥

Some crafting stations, like the Cooking Range and Fermentation Vat, will require fuel to operate. You can create firewood from splitting logs and mine coal ore from deep below in the vampiric ruins for fuel sources.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xPEP9Dq.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KRBThZU.gif[/img]

I hope you enjoy these additions and improvements so far. I’m almost a year into development and am ecstatic about the progress so far. I understand waiting isn’t easy, so thank you for being patient and giving me the time and space needed to create an awesome game.

To folks that celebrate Christmas, Merry Christmas; and to others, and those that find it a stressful time of the year, I hope that you have a restful holiday season. 🎄✨

Borispixel 🦇

notes.title: A Deep Dive into the Vampiric Ruins
notes.notes:
Hey Ranchers!

In this month’s update, I’ll be diving deep into the vampiric ruins that you’ll be able to explore in Vampire Rancher. 

To get to the caves, you’ll need to craft a Blood Compass which can be created from the blood harvested from visitors. The Blood Compass is a special item which points to the entrance of that cave system, which can be anywhere on the map.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Vun3vtF.gif[/img]

The caves and vampiric ruins is a challenging dungeon filled with various loot such as precious metals from mineable rocks, as well as drops from various hostile mobs. The caves range from small (easy) to large (hardest) sizes and difficulties, depending on how the Blood Compass was crafted, so you’ll need to plan your expedition accordingly.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4cCwRGf.gif[/img]

As you progress through the caves, you’ll notice rarer resources start to surface, as well as stronger mobs.

Don’t be afraid of the dark - as you traverse through the caves, you’ll be able to activate beacons to light up sections of the cave. A minimap will also be available so you don’t get disorientated. Light up all beacons to receive a special XP bonus when you exit or complete the dungeon.

At the heart of the dungeon, lies the vampiric ruin. Ah, the pièce de résistance - the boss battles. At the deepest point of the cave system,

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IvK9Q3X.gif[/img]

It’s a boss room with high value resources guarded by an ancient vampire boss. Yes, it’s vampire on vampire action. These vampires have been hibernating for centuries and don’t like to be disturbed, even by their kin. Conveniently, the last beacon will also be located in the boss room so you’ll want to slay the boss to redeem all the bonus XP.

If you feel like you’re running low on items to sustain your expedition, you can exit the cave anytime from the way you came, or with a crafted Escape Rope. You’ll leave with all the items you’ve gathered as well. Be wary - if you overextend your stay, you might lose all your loot if you’re not careful!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/FpD0yUJ.gif[/img]

As a vampire, you’ll also be able to exercise some of your abilities like transfiguring into a bat and echolocating ores and other loot. I’ll be working on adding more vampire abilities in the future as well.

That’s all I have for this month. Thank you to everyone that’s shown interest in playtesting the demo! I’ll be reaching out accordingly on Discord when the time is right.

notes.title: Animal Ranching and Skill Trees
notes.notes:
Hey Ranchers!

We're well in to summer (if you're in the northern hemisphere, at least), and this month I’ll be sharing updates on animal ranching and skill trees.

After completing a quest from Mrs. Brown, you’ll be able to purchase chicks, lambs, piglets, and calves. Given time, food, and attention - these younglings will grow into their adult forms. Adult animals can produce goods, like eggs, wool, milk, etc.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/35s2SNO.gif[/img]

Once animals reach adulthood, they gain a set of traits. Traits are special modifiers that are unique to individual animals. Some of these traits are beneficial, like Gourmand - This animal eats more, and produces more. On the other hand, some traits are less desired: Stinky - This animal gives off an unpleasant odour.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fc1woFE.png[/img]

Adult animals can mate with each other to produce offspring. Offspring get their own traits but can also inherit them from their parents. Beneficial traits are more likely to be inherited, so go wild in trying to cultivate the perfect breed.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bjYQxQ2.gif[/img]

The livestock purchased from Mrs. Brown will have randomized traits, that way you won’t be stuck with unwanted traits forever.

Here are some of the traits for example:
[list]
[*] [b]Chatty[/b] - This animal is more vocal than others.
[*] [b]Magnificent[/b] - This animal rewards more experience when checking for produce.
[*] [b]Stinky[/b] - This animal generates more dirt.
[*] [b]Poopy[/b] - This animal generates more poop.
[*] [b]Hyper[/b] - This animal is faster than others.
[*] [b]Shiny[/b] - This animal has a higher chance of producing higher quality produce.
[*] [b]Sluggish[/b] - This animal is slower than others.
[*] [b]Night Owl[/b] - This animal doesn’t sleep during the night.
[*] [b]Sleepy[/b] - This animal sleeps more during the day.
[*] [b]Snob[/b] - This animal eats less and produces less.
[*] [b]Glutton[/b] - This animal eats more and produces more.
[*] [b]Big Boned[/b] - This animal eats more, and produces faster.
[*] [b]Melancholic[/b] - This animal tends to be in a poor mood.
[*] [b]Jovial[/b] - This animal tends to be in high spirits.
[*] [b]Mellow[/b] - This animal doesn’t get affected by mood swings as much.
[/list]

I’ve also spent some time improving the current XP system. Previously, doing a certain activity e.g. chopping a tree would reward you with woodcutting experience, which you then could use to unlock woodcutting talents.

I've reworked it so that experience won't be siloed to the specific activity your doing, so you'll be able to gain experience from everything, and the talent points are global so you can use it for any skill tree you want to advance.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RgnpbCu.gif[/img]

Here’s a look into the talent tree for woodcutting skill 🌲

[list][*] [b]Backcut II[/b] - Energy cost for using axes reduced by 1 (requires Backcut I)
[*] [b]Second Wind I [/b]- After felling a tree, instantly restore 10% of the energy used to cut that tree.
[*] [b]Second Wind II[/b] - After felling a tree, instantly restore 20% of the energy used to cut that tree. (requires Second Wind I)
[*] [b]Second Wind III[/b] - After felling a tree, instantly restore 30% of the energy used to cut that tree. (requires Second Wind II)
[*] [b]Timber I[/b] - Swing axes faster. (requires Second Wind I)
[*] [b]Timber II[/b]- Swing axes even faster. (requires Timber I)
[*] [b]Aboreal Aptitude[/b] - Chance of receiving loot whilst chopping a tree increased by 10%. (requires Timber I)
[*] [b]Treesplitter I[/b]- Chance of getting an additional drop increased by 25%. (requires Timber I)
[*] [b]Treesplitter II[/b] - Chance of getting an additional drop increased by 25%. (requires Treesplitter I, Second Wind III)
[*] [b]Treesplitter III [/b]- Chance of getting an additional drop increased by 25%. (requires Treesplitter II)
[*] [b]Treehugger I[/b] - Stumped trees have a regrowth rate of 50%. (requires Timber II)[/list]

You can gain experience from harvesting blood from humans, chopping trees, fishing, and serving guests. The skills you can spend your talent points on are woodcutting, farming, fishing, mining, and vampirism.

There have been loads of updates since I first put the Steam store up, so I thought it was a good time to update some of the gameplay screenshots. If you've been following the blog every month (you're amazing ✨) these will look a little familiar:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8Y3FHWa.jpg[/img]

Thank you to everyone that’s shown interest in playtesting the demo! I’ll be reaching out accordingly on Discord when the time is right. As always, if you're interested, please join our Discord and let me know!

notes.title: Create Your Vampire, Gifts, and Hotels
notes.notes:
Hey Ranchers!

It's the 1st of the month and you know what time it is - more updates! This month, I've been working on a highly requested feature, player (or vampire) customization. Here's what it looks like in action ✨

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NO4eajm.gif[/img]

Over time, I'll be adding more hairstyles, outfits, and colors so you'll be able to mix and match as you please. You'll also be able to customize your bat form. I'm also looking for suggestions if you have a favorite hairstyle you want me to add!

Interacting with your townsfolk is essential to building relationships and completing quests. Here's Clara in the General Store receiving a gift you got her.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Sj6icVx.gif[/img]

Apart from the General Store, I've also started working on what the Hotel looks like from the inside. [b]Chauncey[/b], the hotel's concierge is there ready to greet and serve guests that visit your town.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CyqtxfG.png[/img]

As part of maintaining your town, you'll be able to customize, upgrade, and manage the rooms in the Hotel to cater to specific guests. Each room will have a cleanliness and prestige score depending on what furniture is placed in it, and how clean it is while it's occupied.

notes.title: Meet Kale and Clara
notes.notes:
Can you believe it's May already? Welcome back to another Vampire Rancher devlog. Today, we're excited to share some exciting progress on the latest features we've been working on for our game.

First up, I’ve been hard at work adding two new characters for the game. Say Hello to Kale and Clara!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/swnP4MP.png[/img]

[b]Kale[/b] is a hardworking and honest person who takes pride in his work. He is a little shy, but friendly once you get to know him. He has a dry sense of humor and enjoys making puns and jokes. Kale works in the Saloon and helps the player with cooking advice and selling them recipes.

[b]Clara[/b] is a kind and nurturing person who enjoys taking care of others. She has a talent for gardening and is always willing to share her knowledge with others. She is a friend to the player character, offering gardening advice and selling them seeds and other supplies.

As expected, players can interact with these characters to begin quests, give gifts, or start special events.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1MMKI9u.gif[/img]

Speaking of quests, I’ve also been working on a new quest system that will tie in with the new dialog system. I’m hoping to make quests story-rich rather than boring fetch quests, so you’ll be able to connect with the characters and learn more about the world.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LBkLdoF.gif[/img]

In addition, we've also added a new building to the game: the town hall. This building will allow players to keep track of their collectables and progression. As you repair and contribute more to the town hall, expect new rewards to show up as well.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/l2rroq4.gif[/img]

As always, please let us know if you have any feedback or suggestions, and stay tuned for more updates as we continue to develop Vampire Rancher.

notes.title: Creating Cozy Interiors
notes.notes:
Hey Ranchers!

This month, I've been working on adding interior lighting for buildings and furniture. This new addition will allow players to customize the look and feel of their buildings, creating unique and cozy environments for their visitors.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/pfxhHQy.gif[/img]

Players can craft a range of interior furniture for the saloon, hotel, and other buildings which can have a practical impact on the game. For example, visitors will use tables and chairs in the saloon while eating, and sleep in beds in the hotel rooms.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QOcFE16.png[/img]

Crafted items made from better resources provide higher stats in comfort and attractiveness, which can affect your visitor's happiness. When crafting an item, players can choose from a variety of different resources, ranging from basic materials like wood and stone to exotic resources found in other places (more to come on that in a later post).

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tBS8qap.gif[/img]

I've also been working through a lot of under-the-hood improvements. One goal was to make the save system more reliable and robust, ensuring that players' saved games are not corrupted or lost. notes.title: Can Vampires even farm garlic? (Farming Update)
notes.notes:
Hey Ranchers!

I’ve been [i]digging[/i] deep into farming this month, and I’m excited to share updates on the farming skill in Vampire Rancher.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Xr5UcfB.gif[/img]

Players can grow various crops, like carrots, cabbage, and onions, and harvest them for resources for crafting and food recipes! In Vampire Rancher, recipes are essential to determine the travellers visiting your town.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gqZVu75.gif[/img]

Like any good farm, you’ll have to water your crops for them to grow. You can also supplement these crops with compost and fertilizers that you craft for healthier growth and a more significant yield. Apart from tiling farmland on the ground, you can also plant crops in allotment plots for a more aesthetic look.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43543621/7757c86aafdfc1f358bd4bf38c9ab5ac50cc7717.png[/img]

So what’s next? I’m experimenting with mechanics such as Overgrown and Disease that you’ll have to address if one of your crops falls ill or won’t grow until they are treated. These events have a low chance of happening, and you’ll be able to use fertilizers, potions, or even your vampiric abilities might help navigate some of these challenges.

If you come across rocks, trunks, or other debris you find on the ground, give it a good dig! You’ll find various treasures, including seeds, cooking ingredients, and even ores.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qnhEcR8.gif[/img]

When your vampire powers get strong enough, you’ll even be able to farm garlic. Humans love garlic in their recipes (more to come on in a later update!).

As always, please let us know if you have any feedback or suggestions; and what crops you’d like to see in the game!

Boris

notes.title: Improving Building Mode
notes.notes:
Hello Ranchers!

I'm excited to share some updates on our building system in our game. I’ve implemented a major change to switch from a free-form building system to a grid-based one. I hope that this improves the building experience making it easier and more intuitive for our players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43543621/71e7f9e5d2676452c468cc99fe3c6ec32b039b2f.gif[/img]

With the new grid-based system, players can snap things into place, ensuring that objects are properly aligned and maintaining a consistent look and feel throughout the world. Some objects will also be rotatable so that you can customize placements to your liking!

Additionally, this paves the way for more advanced building mechanics, such as the ability to stack objects or items on top of each other. For example, after placing a table, you would be able to place things on the table like bowls or cups, as well as place a rug below the table to enhance the decor.

I really like this animation for placing down plant pots - how it pops up, super satisfying. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43543621/b3618bf512060858eb1c5cd6acdd28043f2f708b.gif[/img]

As always, please let us know if you have any feedback or suggestions, and stay tuned for more updates!

Thanks,
Borispixel
